summary: This Is an Exercise is a 2006 album by experimental electropop artist Anna Oxygen, released on Kill Rock Stars. The note quotes an Allmusic review calling the album fascinating yet chilly and alienating. According to the review, Oxygen's songs explore issues of authenticity, creation, and consumption similar to those of Tracy + the Plastics, but with a sci-fi/fantasy bent.
